facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Health unveiled a 2026-2030 national health recovery strategy that prioritises digital transformation through DHIS2, per DHIS2's post.
The 2026-2030 national health recovery strategy puts DHIS2 at the core of the digital health system and aims to connect all health facilities through it.

A General Administration of Information director calls the DHIS2-based health information system the backbone of the country, and the WHO representative cites improved information coverage achieved during the war.
